description: This file defines the class `EmailsSignatureResolver` which manages email signature resolution, handling HTML and plaintext signatures, detecting ambiguities, and logging errors, as part of the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: EmailsSignatureResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving email signatures from provided data, handling ambiguous cases, and logging errors.

methods.name: setSignatureArray
methods.description: Sets the signature array, resolves HTML and plaintext signatures, and logs errors if ambiguities or missing signatures are found.

methods.name: resolveHtml
methods.description: Resolves the HTML signature from the signature array, detects ambiguities, and logs errors.

methods.name: resolvePlaintext
methods.description: Resolves the plaintext signature from the signature array, detects ambiguities, and logs errors.

methods.name: isNoDefaultAvailable
methods.description: Indicates whether no default signatures are available (both HTML and plaintext).
